title: Central corneal thickness changes following manual small incision cataract surgery

license.statement: CC BY-NC 3.0 unported via Dove Medical Press (article <permissions>: copyright statement and <license> ext-link http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/3.0/); not CC BY or CC0, so the record is private

indication: Cataract (bilateral mature cataract in 47%) in consecutive adult patients at Lagos University Teaching Hospital, Nigeria; corneal opacity or endothelial disease (including guttata), other ocular disease, traumatic or complicated cataract, previous refractive surgery, one-eyed patients and operative complications such as vitreous loss excluded

groups.description: Manual small incision cataract surgery (superior 6-7 mm sclerocorneal tunnel, nucleus delivery with viscoelastic or irrigating Simcoe cannula, Ringer's lactate or saline irrigation, PMMA posterior chamber IOL), single surgeon, local anaesthesia; operated eyes of 200 consecutive patients, 2012-2013

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the operated eye measured the day before surgery (Table 2 row 'Day 0', column 'Mean CCTo'; Methods and Results: 'CCT measurements a day before cataract surgery'); ultrasonic SUOER SW 100 A-scan pachymeter, mean of three readings
series.notes: Table 2 column 'Mean CCTo' (operated eye), mean ± SD in µm; rows Day 0 (preoperative), Day 1 (a day after surgery, days/30.4375), 2, 4, 8 and 12 weeks (weeks×7/30.4375). Per-visit n not reported (200 operated eyes analysed).

exclusions.reason: Unoperated fellow eye used as within-patient control

exclusions.what: Table 2 column 'CCTo (day 0–various time sets)' and the 'P-value' and 'Confidence interval (95%)' columns
exclusions.reason: Paired differences (day 0 minus follow-up) of the same series whose absolute CCT is tabulated, and p-values/intervals, are not used or not admissible

notes: Single standard-procedure cohort (MSICS without an investigational agent): control role. The study's 'controls' are the unoperated contralateral eyes, which are excluded.
Table 2 labels the preoperative measurement 'Day 0'; Methods state it was taken a day before surgery, so it is the preoperative reference, not a postoperative day 0.
At 8 and 12 weeks the tabulated paired difference does not equal the difference of the tabulated means; per-visit n is not reported, so the absolute means are used as tabulated.
